records.synonyms_note: Mimosa borealis var. texana A.Gray is a synonym; WFO lists varieties texana and filipes under the accepted species concept.
records.concept_caution: Older M. biuncifera/aculeaticarpa treatments and two infraspecific concepts must not be conflated. WFO taxon evidence, not an independently retrieved POWO species page; original source specimens not identified.
records.handoff: Preserve existing canonical and prior evidence; no range, media, or other lane changes.
